title: Settings
subtitle: Configure preferences and manage API keys for external services.

general.title: General Preferences
general.languageDescription: Choose the display language for OpenReel
general.projectCompositionDescription: Canvas dimensions for your project. Choose a preset tailored for TikTok, Reels, YouTube, or type custom values.
general.editingFrameRateDescription: Controls preview playback, step intervals, and default export frame rate. Existing clip timings are preserved.
general.backgroundFillDescription: When clip aspect ratio doesn't match the project, automatically fill empty space.
general.autoSaveDescription: Automatically save your project at regular intervals
general.aiConnectionsDescription: Connect your own compatible API endpoints. OpenReel respects your ownership and never locks you into a vendor.
general.endpointDescription: Enter your API host and a tool-use capable model supported by that host.
general.modelDiscoveryHelp: You can discover available models in the agent chat settings, or enter a model ID manually. API key is optional.
general.aiAggregatorDescription: Image and video generation, upscaling, and creative tools

apiKeys.title: External Services & API Keys
apiKeys.description: API keys are encrypted locally using AES-GCM and never leave your device.
apiKeys.sessionLockedDesc: Enter your master password to view or edit stored keys.

mcp.desktopOnlyDesc: The MCP server runs inside the OpenReel desktop app, letting external AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline) edit your project. Open OpenReel on desktop to configure it.
mcp.serverDesc: A local Model Context Protocol server lets AI clients drive this editor through the same tools as the built-in chat. It listens on loopback only and requires the bearer token below.
mcp.tokenRotatedDesc: Update your MCP clients with the new token.
mcp.workflowsDesc: The live catalog includes focused tools for each desktop workspace.

videoEditor.label: Video Editor
videoEditor.desc: Tracks, clips, effects, transitions, audio and subtitles

motionCreator.label: Motion Creator
motionCreator.desc: Layers, animation, shaders, masks, effects and render queue

creation3d.label: Creation & 3D
creation3d.desc: Scenes, products, materials, cameras, rigging and previews

projectOps.label: Project Operations
projectOps.desc: Inspect, import, save, undo, export and diagnostics

mcp.clientSetupDesc: Add this to your MCP client config (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline). The shim connects to the running app automatically.
mcp.autoAllowDesc: When off, destructive or expensive tool calls over MCP are refused with a confirmation-required notice. Turn on only if you trust every connected local client.

descriptions.setup: Create a master password to encrypt your API keys. This password is never stored — only a verification hash is kept.
descriptions.unlock: Enter your master password to access encrypted API keys.
descriptions.change: Change your master password. All stored keys will be re-encrypted.

masterPassword.min8Chars: Password must be at least 8 characters
masterPassword.min8CharsNew: New password must be at least 8 characters
masterPassword.operationFailed: Operation failed. Check your current password.
masterPassword.encryptionNotice: Your password is used to derive an encryption key via PBKDF2 (100k iterations). API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. If you forget this password, stored keys cannot be recovered.
